status: implemented; terminal quantity gate failed; no spatial fitting or eligible checkpoint
scientific_question: Can the model localize uncertain future tissue more accurately than persistence while preserving a credible distribution of whether and how much tissue exists?

population.matching: unchanged original pairs and four-week target window

state.forecast_inputs: declared cutoff state, availability, requested horizon; current-only initially

presence.event: at least one native reference voxel of compartment c; annotation presence, not adjudicated biological truth
presence.prediction: explicit p(Z | cutoff state, horizon), with marginal presence probabilities
presence.loss: proper log score for the presence distribution; unknown annotation events masked
evaluation: reliability with sample counts and patient uncertainty
false absence and false presence at a predeclared 0.5 marginal-probability threshold

amount.positive_support: positive voxel counts when Z_c=1; exactly zero when Z_c=0
amount.joint_support: sum of foreground counts <= N, the declared cutoff-derived anatomical-domain capacity; background is the remainder
amount.domain: fixed from cutoff data before forecasting; same across horizons and compared methods; cannot use future anatomy
amount.reference: frozen improved-state scalar predictor, plus persistence
evaluation: unconditional mixture volume CRPS including zero mass
conditional positive-amount scores on reference-present cases
90% coverage and width, conditional and unconditional separately
amount.legacy_scalar_conditional_undefined: if its positive mass is zero, report conditional distribution undefined; never remove that case from unconditional comparison

location.variable: exclusive native compartment map S | Z,V,cutoff state,horizon
location.quantization: integer counts are authoritative; any continuous proposal is explicitly quantized upstream with per-compartment error <= one native voxel and must preserve Z and total capacity
location.conservation: decoded count equals the supplied integer count for every compartment in every sample; no overlap; background fills remaining domain
location.infeasible_policy: retain sample identifier, requested quantities, capacity and failure reason; no silent clipping, dropping, renormalization or rejection resampling
location.eligibility: any unreported or unresolved infeasible sample, count mismatch or overlap fails implementation acceptance
location.target_outside_cutoff_domain: report and score as a miss; do not expand domain from future references
location.image_readout: conditioned on the same sampled map and declared state

selection.scope: all original selection targets, separately at 12 and 24 weeks; no favorable horizon or presence-subset replacement
selection.weights: mean over targets within each patient, then equal patients; equal horizons for ranking
selection.nonempty_core_subset: future reference core count > 0, applied only by the evaluator after forecast generation
selection.gate_type: development point-estimate constraint, not a clinical tolerance or population noninferiority claim

hard_constraints_each_horizon.metric: expected sample-wise core Dice on reference-present core targets
MAE of unconditional predictive mean core volume on reference-present targets
unconditional core volume CRPS on reference-present targets
hard_constraints_each_horizon.control: frozen improved-state scalar core volume CRPS

selection.ranking_among_eligible: highest patient/horizon/compartment-balanced expected sample-wise Dice over all four compartments; then lower marginal presence Brier; then lower unconditional volume CRPS; then earlier update
selection.no_eligible_outcome: no_eligible_checkpoint; retain final and diagnostic checkpoints but label none selected or accepted
selection.sampling: exact finite-mixture expectations where available; otherwise fix and record the Monte Carlo draw count and shared random stream before any fitting; no resampling to pass a gate

scientific_assessment.localization: expected sample-wise compartment Dice against persistence; separate nonempty/empty and stable/changed results, plus spatial proper scores
scientific_assessment.distribution: unconditional and conditional volume-distribution scores against frozen scalar control, with paired patient intervals and coverage/width
scientific_assessment.presence: proper probability scores against fitting-only horizon-specific presence prevalence and deterministic current-state persistence
scientific_assessment.joint_claim: requires evidence for improved localization and credible presence/amount distributions; report unresolved contrasts without a useful-forecasting claim

display.representative_map: one predeclared sampled scenario selected without target information; display its exact map-derived volumes and scenario identity
display.distribution_mean: mean of volume samples, separately labeled; never described as the representative map volume
display.marginal_argmax_map: if shown, separately labeled; its derived volumes are neither the scenario amounts nor distribution mean
display.presence_probabilities: display explicitly alongside conditional positive-amount and unconditional intervals

implementation.amount: autoregressive discretized logistic on log native count, truncated to remaining capacity with one voxel reserved per later present compartment
implementation.streams: SHA256 amount-first-v1:17:patient|cutoff|horizon, midpoint uniforms; shared across methods
implementation.quantity_fit: one seed17, 6000 updates, terminal candidate; AdamW inherited schedule
implementation.early_exit: nonempty-core mean MAE <= persistence AND CRPS <= frozen scalar, separately at each horizon; otherwise no spatial fit
implementation.location_fit: if quantity passes, freeze quantity; 6000 updates; all58 selection every1000; existing full eligibility/ranking unchanged
implementation.allocation: descending native ranking, ascending flat voxel index ties; sequential core/enhancing/cavity/FLAIR; exact requested counts
